**Switzerland: scale and change.** Across 2000–2025, the extract records 620,749 applications. The largest annual volume was 39,620 in 2002; 2025 recorded 25,755. Applications in 2025 were 81% higher than in 2019 (14,215). In 2025, 31,210 recorded decisions equated to 121 per 100 applications, so recorded output exceeded incoming volume. Applications in 2025 were 7.0% lower than in 2024 (27,694). Applications exceeded recorded decisions in 2 of 5 comparable years during 2021-2025. The leading recorded origins that year were Afghanistan (6,207), Eritrea (3,415), Türkiye (2,534).

In 2025, the substantive protection rate was 59%, across 20,128 grants and refusals; closures accounted for 36% of all recorded decisions. That protection rate was 11.4 percentage points lower than in 2024 (71%).
